facts.value: Provides audio feedback for Ness's forward-smash reflector by unconditionally calling ft_PlaySFX with the fighter and constants 0xE0, 0x7F, and 0x40. The callback contains no visual-effect operation or local reflection decision.
facts.rationale: Independently confirms the librarian's audio-only correction to the audiovisual baseline.

evidence.why: Complete callback consists of one fixed sound call.
Actual reflector registration establishes its move-specific role.

facts.value: Requests removal of the bat tracked by a valid fighter: when u.ns.bat_gobj is non-NULL, passes it to it_802AD6B8 and clears the fighter slot after the call. The callee clears the item's fighter and owner references before invoking Item_8026A8EC. This null guard does not establish stale-handle or reentrant-cleanup safety.
facts.rationale: Replaces the baseline's broad safe-teardown guarantee with independently verified operation order and explicit preconditions.

evidence.why: Null guard, removal call, and post-call fighter-slot clear.
Reciprocal references are cleared before generic removal is invoked.

facts.value: Clears a valid fighter's non-NULL u.ns.bat_gobj slot without dereferencing or destroying the referenced item. Item-side ownership cleanup uses this helper when its recorded fighter equals its owner; this is pointer bookkeeping, not proof that item destruction has already completed.
facts.rationale: Removes the unsupported after-lifetime ordering from the baseline while preserving verified reciprocal cleanup purpose.

evidence.why: Reciprocal caller checks recorded fighter against item owner.
Ownership clearing precedes the returned removal condition.
